name: OMTech FC-105 Fiber
tagline: Industrial fiber laser cutter for sheet metal (not a desktop marker)
tldr: OMTech FC-105 is a fiber laser cutting platform for metal sheet: a different class from desktop galvo markers. Listed for buyers who search 'fiber laser' and need to understand cutters vs markers.
mainObjective: Sheet metal fiber cutting for fabrication shops

priceRange.note: Official OMTech store, Oct 2026: listed at $59,999 (quote-based; 1.5 to 4 kW IPG source)

engraveExample.description: Filled logo on stainless steel plate

pros: Fiber cuts sheet metal: does not cut wood or acrylic
Software listed on the profile: test your workflow (LightBurn or maker app) on scrap first
Work area 3050 × 1530 mm (5 × 10 ft): confirm floor space, 3-phase power and loading before you order
cons: Does not cut wood, leather, or acrylic: sheet metal cutting only
Fume extraction still matters for coated metals and marking sprays
beginnerNotes: This profile covers OMTech FC-105 Fiber. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Run scrap tests first. Use this profile’s reference times for quotes, not marketing claims.
primaryUse: Industrial sheet metal fiber laser cutting.

editorialDepth.advantages: OMTech FC-105 Fiber is an industrial fiber cutter (1.5–4 kW IPG source, 3050 × 1530 mm bed) for steel, stainless and aluminum parts. It suits fabrication shops that want to bring sheet cutting in-house instead of outsourcing.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip for engraving, wood, leather or acrylic, or without 3-phase 380 V power, assist gas and floor space for a multi-ton machine. Pricing is quote-based and installation is a project of its own.
